options.name: auto_update
options.description: Whether software autoupdate should be enabled for the fabric.

options.name: descr
options.description: The text description of the IRF member switch.

options.name: domain_id
options.description: The domain ID for the IRF fabric.

options.name: mad_exclude
options.description: Interface or list of interfaces that should be excluded from shutting down in a recovery event.

options.name: member_id
options.description: Current IRF member ID of the switch. If the switch has not been configured for IRF yet, this should be 1.

options.name: new_member_id
options.description: The desired IRF member ID for the switch. The new member ID takes effect after a reboot.

options.name: priority
options.description: The desired IRF priority for the switch.

options.name: reboot
options.description: Whether to reboot the switch after member id changes are made.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the interfaces listed in mad_exclude
